notes.title: Beebo& Luna v1.0.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamcatcher,
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]To enhance your gaming experience, we’ve released a new update for Beebo&Luna. Below are the key improvements:
[olist]
Fixed character image display issues in the storyline.

Resolved the issue where save file conflicts prevented unlocking of theme content and guests (excluding the "Fantasy Worlds" theme).

Fixed Beebo’s mouse cursor tracking problem.

Repaired certain decoration animations for Beebo.

Optimized game performance and fixed multiple bugs.
[/olist][p align="start"]We hope Beebo will always accompany you, bringing joy to your days!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Best regards,

Dorimora Studio

notes.title: Beebo& Luna Demo v0.1.7 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, to create a better dream-catching environment, we've released some new content and made a few adjustments!

Here's what's new in this update:

New Player Tutorial: We've added a comprehensive tutorial module to help new players get started and understand the game mechanics more easily.

Beebo Desktop Interactions: Look forward to brand-new interactive animations for Beebo when Beebo on your desktop!

Smoother Dressing Room Camera Transitions: Moving the camera in the dressing room is now much more fluid.

Story BGM: We've added several background music tracks that play during story segments.

Bug Fixes: We've addressed multiple bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.

If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out for help in our Discord group. We're always happy to assist!


Click to join us: https://discord.gg/fyJheuBa
